newsitem.title: LATVIA: NEW RIETUMU HEAD PLANS NEW PRODUCTS-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: NEW RIETUMU HEAD PLANS NEW PRODUCTS-REPORT.

text.p: The new president of Rietumu Bank, central bank EU PHARE advisor Michael Bourke, plans to launch new products, focussing on currencies and investments, he said in an interview with Bizness I Baltiya published on Monday.
Bourke, who has been in Latvia for five years, was one of the closest advisors to central bank chief Einar Repshe.
"Our plans include, the launch of new products and services, Mainly, currency operations, work with investments and the servicing of corporate clients," Bourke told the newspaper.
He also said that the development of Latvia's transit industry was important.
"We need qualified bank services to service Western investments, which will undoubtedly will grow," he added.
Bourke also said that Latvia could develop as an offshore bank centre for eastern Europe but that very clear laws were needed to avoid becoming a centre ofr money laundering.
